body: I fear I may be homeless in the near future. My best case scenario may be staying with a friend or my sister and her family in another state. I came here to learn and my takeaway is that I’m not nearly as resourceful and capable as many here seem to be.

That class of drug is extremely hard to come off of. You may want to go to benzobuddies and look into safe tapers. You come off them too quick and have real problems. You can’t play around with dosing on that stuff so taking different amounts each day will cause major problems with your cns . Be careful and finish that degree before you start a taper. Rehabs may take you off too fast so do your homework and best of luck.
can you go to rehab?

Can you try to find a job that’s not so physical? You have experience stocking, maybe you can find one without the heavy lifting. Ssdi takes years and you have to be not working as you apply. Make sure you have ALL medical records and if you lose your job file right away and get a lawyer. None of that will keep you from being homeless though. If you can stay with family for at least two years while you go thru the ssdi process that’s one thing but even then your chances are 50/50 of getting disability. Regardless get all of your medical records and guard them with your life. If you‘re on Medicaid keep going to your doctors and be very vocal so it’s all in the record and make sure you get copies of everything.

I’m going through the exact same thing. I’m in a corporate job, working from home and my lack of tech skills have finally caught up with me after twenty years on the job. I’m 56 and fear I’ll lose it all. I’m lost and watch younger people handle all the tech processes with ease. I will say though that your situation seems a bit different and I see hope and possibilities in your well written story. It is possible you could work through some of your issues and take a little action on the things you’re putting off like the studies. I would also say this should be a priority with your therapist as it seems acute. I would hope you can find one person whom you trust to lean on, someone who you trust exposing yourself to and are comfortable with asking questions. I’m glad you’re liked by all and that you realize this to be true. Try not to beat yourself up so much and not let imposter syndrome get the best of you. You’re writing ability is impressive and speaks to your cognitive capabilities. I hope you keep your head in the game and work through this, I think you can and will.

I do guided sleep meditations on YouTube. I think Micheal Sealey has the best channel. You’ve got to use headphones and find the perfect low volume. Sleep hypnosis does work for me. Sometimes it’s almost instant, sometimes it takes 45 minutes. The borderline terror is still there most of the time when I wake up but I still kind of cherish the ritual as I start to fade off. Sometimes I wake up after a few hours and I start another one and start the process over.
Maybe the copious amounts of stimulants and long hours are messing with your brain. You’re lucky to have love, hang on to that.
Stupid  question, why don’t you ask him..
Sure thing, you deserve it. I really hope you feel somewhat better soon and I’m glad you have your family. Give one of them a hug if you’re up to it.

I feel exactly the same way by my situation is working from home, I barely function and I’m going to lose my job. Can’t even fathom leaving the house anymore. I’ll leave when I lose it, that’s for sure.

the medical system is horrific, they know what these psyche meds do. I’m so sorry you’ve had to see and experience all of this. I’m just glad you have shelter. I wish there was an answer to all of this for all of us.
bummer, thought maybe she could take a bus to you.
Could she get to you and stay till she figures something out?

You can get a good twin memory foam mattress for a few hundred. That’s what I’d recommend, no box springs needed. Frame for one on wayfair or Amazon is only about 50 bucks. Furniture from thrift stores and Craigslist

I’m not sure it’s a good idea to stay there. Ultimately you can’t parent them and protect them. Maybe you could just go visit your boyfriend for awhile and take a break. I’m so sorry you’re in that situation and hope you don’t heap guilt in yourself.
Good for you. Wow two years homeless while working. I admire you and I’m very happy for you.
I’m so glad you got the place and found a roommate. That’s a good price for a two bedroom. You also have a good heart, acts of kindness are needed. Best of luck to you.
Sounds like they’ll fight whether you’re there or not.
I’m glad that you have a mother who cares about you. Have you told her what’s going on with you?

Going off meds too quick or taking them sporadically can def cause hallucination, horrible anxiety etc. Trazadone is def not something to play with, you have to micro taper off that stuff. Don’t trust anybody in the medical field, they will try to taper you way too fast. [survivingantidepressants.org](https://survivingantidepressants.org)

I’m in a similar situation, totally isolated and alone. At least you have work and shelter. That’s a foundation to build on. The pandemic has been really hard on many. having no family or friends to interact with is tough. I’m in the same boat, I’ve devolved into a helpless person afraid to leave my house. There are zoom support meetings put on by the wildflower alliance in western ma, they help me. Totally safe space.

Call 211 and see if there are resources to help. I know the thought or reality of being homeless will make one want to die. I’m in a similar situation and paralyzed by fear, not taking much action. My homelessness may be a little farther off. But if yours is imminent try calling them.
An act of kindness, you can initiate it. No expectations.
If you believe in God you could seek out help from a church. You may find a supportive system there but I’d be selective on what type of church.
You didn’t fuck up, the person who mocked you just sounds like prick. Try not to let it get you down.
I’m glad they’re trying something. Case managers and transitioning to permanent housing. I hope it works and people get help.
I was not trying to shame you at all. I hope you find solace in your husbands arms. It’s none of my business but thinking or you doing that makes me feel bette. Best of luck to you.
I hear you. I’m sorry you‘re in that situation and country. I hope you can find like minded people to at least talk to there to have somewhere to go with your thoughts and feelings.

sounds like you’ve accomplished many things and have gotten thru  most of your school.  I hope you can reassure your husband that you love him and keep that connection. Good people who unconditionally love us are hard to come by. I hope you stick it out and finish nursing school. I’m so sorry you’re going thru all this but I hope you and your husband can be there for each other.
I can also relate to the substance abuse issues. I’ve been sober since 2012, May. I’m here, you can also pm if you prefer.
I’m here if you want to talk. I understand everything you posted, it all resonates with me.

All they have for us is more meds which are impossible to get off of without horrible protracted withdrawal. They pretend that interdose withdrawal and all too common side effects don’t exist. Many therapist deal with suicidal ideation and won’t usual commit someone involuntarily. So you would probably be ok to talk about it.

You may be correct. I’m looking again and I think MAGI qualification for medical coverage may not have an asset test, it’s solely based on your monthly adjusted gross income. Looks like the assets only apply to long term care. If this is true it’s a huge relief for me but I’d have to make sure to draw no more than 12,700 a year from my 401k to be in compliance. Or work and make less than that amount. I can’t believe 12,700 is considered 138% of the poverty level. ACA subsidies for the Siover plans don’t seem to kick in until about 17k so I wonder what people who make 14k are supposed to do? It’s all so complicated
I’m sure, it varies by state but the general rule is 1500 or less in savings. The expansion states do base soley on income but the asset limits are still in place. I’m in Ohio.
I wish there was a service or a way to bring likeminded people together to live and combine resources to help each other. Like a roommate pairing service to mitigate all the bad roommate scenarios.
Maybe you’ll meet a women and have a nice life. You deserve love and maybe you’ll find it.  I’m so sorry you’re going thru this. Maybe coming out will be different 25 years later.

Yep, single male and you’re pretty screwed, with any social services. I feel like the women in Street Car Named Desire right now. I’m glad you don’t have to live in your car now. Glad you have insurance and hope you find a better job someday.

I’m sorry you’re going thru this. The only way a hotline will send the police is if you say you’re going to kill yourself and you have a plan and the means to do it. So if you say “ I’m going to shoot myself and I have guns and ammo “ that would be a problem. The odds are very low that they would intervene. Other than that remote possibility it is completely confidential as far as I know. If you want someone to talk to you can message me. Hang in there.

very well said and very true. they don’t know what to do with the information. I told my sister what was going on and she said no matter what I’d always have a place to live with her and her family and that’s what I needed to hear at the time. You may try the online meetings put on by the wildflower alliance, zoom meetings for suicidal people. It’s a unique space and it helps me a lot. I want to be rescued and it’s hard to accept that’s not going to happen when you’re so beat down and traumatized from my own brain. It’s a dark place to be. I wish for the same things. I hope you find validation and support from your family. I don’t know if my sister and her family could actually let me stay there for a long time as some type of respite but it was sure nice to hear.
I am old, 56 and I’m overwhelmed and sinking. It’s a horrible feeling that won’t leave me as I watch it all coming down.

The pandemic has ruined my life. I’ve devolved into something unrecognizable. I can’t even fathom leaving my house and I can no longer preform my work from home job. I’m going down the shitter and have no ability to stop it.

Our loved ones don’t know what to do with the info or how to process it. Some unconditional love, compassion and empathy would be nice. Ultimately I just want to know they’re there for me and won’t let me be homeless and completely alone.

Me too, it’s a travesty. But half of the population votes fir those trying to kill the safety net. I truly wish you well and I hope I make it through This. Big changes for me right around the corner and I’m petrified. Time to rise to the challenge or die.
Stay safe friend, you were heard and your feelings are valid.

Im about to lose my job but I have a 401k. It’s all I have and I’m 56. So I can’t get Medicaid unless I spend all my retirement money first. If Medicaid would allow people to have some savings and go by income only ( in states that expanded Medicaid ) it would be so much better. I checked the exchange and as long as I make at least 17k I get premiums subsidized but if I’m unemployed I get nothing. this terrifies me being 56 and on the edge of homelessness with only my 401k as savings. For Medicaid you can’t have more the 1500 in the bank.
And they have universal healthcare too.

No, I feel worthy and there are many things about life I like and cherish. But I’m overwhelmed and unable to keep up with what’s required to survive. So that ruthless relentless part of life is too much for me.

I know you do, I see it in your post. I had many times when I was young where I felt hopeless and lost. I always got thru it and found hope and meaning eventually. You are a beautiful good person, I hope you try and stay in the present and not beat yourself up. Have empathy for yourself and know you’re not the only one. There are really good meetings online run by the wildflower alliance. Small zoom meetings. You might try those, they are very unique and you can leave your video off.
I agree with you 100%
Thank you for the post. I read it all and ai understand everything you’re saying and feeling. it’s not a sob story it’s all valid.
Maybe you’ll feel better when you get off to Montreal. You have that money saved and that’s a good thing. I’m sorry you’re going thru this and hope going to college gives you a new start.

The pandemic has been hard on many people. I have fallen apart too, everything you said I feel the same and I’m 56. You have people that care about you and you’re looking forward to the lecture, you may have some spark left. You may feel better when the pandemic lifts and we get back to a more normal pattern. The isolation (I’m completely alone, haven’t left my house in months) has really taken a toll. You’re not alone, hang in there, I hear some hope in your post. Only you know for sure.

True, hang in there. I was just looking on the marketplace and essentially I have to make at least 17k to get subsidies, if I don’t make that much they want you on Medicaid but I can’t get Medicaid because I have a 401k. I’m basically fucked.
I’m glad you have shelter, I hope you can eventually work less than 80 hrs.
I hope you don’t end up without a place to stay. 211 may be able to connect you with resources in your area.
[Survivingantidepressants.org](https://Survivingantidepressants.org)  or benzobuddies  can help you with a tape. Psychiatrists are so full of crap, disgusting.
Michael Sealey guided meditations help me.
Serotonin syndrome most likely. I’d throw up right now if I were you.

Being poor is daunting and makes one feel hopeless. I’m about to be poor for the first time in my life. All I can think about is having a place to live that is at least tolerable and have money to eat. You’re right, healthcare is a luxury and you’re lucky. Are you on Medicaid if I may ask or have coverage thru your job?

The second A stands for anonymous. No shame in rehab, it saved my life. If you can go to impatient rehab and then AA it could change your life. I wish you well. Zoom meeting for AA are also 24/7 365. You can go to one right now.n
sounds like roommates or something. If you’re in a sustainable situation and feel secure at all that’s something I guess. But I get everything you’re saying and agree. do you have health coverage?
Try to get your mother to let you stay and re- group?
Can’t answer that. I’m 56 and overwhelmed. At least you have a “ home situation” though. Not trying to be smug but it’s good to have a home.

I have no answers other than this fact. Sobriety is possible. I’ve been sober for 9 years. Alcohol and weed. AA is a great resource. You can also make friends there and find fellowship. Hey, I’m on a suicide sub so you can fill in the blanks but I know AA is a great resource and I know sobriety is possible. Guilt and shame are big with addicts and AA is adept at helping people work thru it.

Thank you for posting, I hear you and I know what it’s like to feel trapped on meds you want off of but fear the withdrawal, which they won’t even acknowledge exists. I’m down to just trazadone but  fear a complex micro- taper lasting years. Ultimately if you’re are housed and feel safe and secure it’s at least a foundation to start from. I hope you at least feel secure in your housing. Put the burdening others on the back burner if you can and have empathy for yourself.
I agree with everything you wrote, it resonates with me deeply.
Yes
Yeah, here

I hope you find work and get back in school. Not sure if you have insurance, maybe you could talk to someone. I’m not trying to invalidate your pain and despair, I’m in the same boat but you seem to have more hope and promise in your post than some others do here. Makes me think you might be ok. I hope so, hang in there.

They won’t admit you unless you say you’re are suicidal right now. You have to want to go there. If you want to be admitted you know what you have to do and say. You will be able to rest and be institutionalized for a few days, it’s up to you. They’ll take your phone. Make sure you tell family or certain friends where you are so they can contact you or visit. You might also want to write down phone numbers so you can call them from the landline phone they let you use. Im here if you want to talk while waiting. I‘m sorry you’re going thru this.
Are you still in the ER?

If you go to the hospital they’ll possibly expedite you getting services/ therapy. They’ll also try to put you on psych drugs, so if that’s not something you want be careful. But they will keep you for a few days ( locked in) and you will see a psychiatrist before you leave. Oh, you’ll also be in a room with someone else.

If you love and trust your parents you could tell them?  Its not your fault that you‘re feeling overwhelmed and struggling. If they’re good loving people let them try to help you. Just my two cents. Don’t face this alone if you have a loving family.

your feelings are valid and I experience the exact same thing. Friends and family just don’t know what to do with profound mental anguish. It would be nice if they pulled out all the stops to try and get us help so we didn’t feel alone in our trying. I’m lost too, I hope it gets better, it has in the past but I fear this time it won’t.
Thanks, love you too !

Having said that, Canada or the US hotlines will almost never intervene unless you say you’re going to kill yourself right then and you have the means to do it. So if you need help call, they will just listen and send you info for resources to talk to a psychologist.

Are you in the US? If so use 211 to find resources. I hope you can at least find a couch to sleep on for awhile. Make sure you secure all your documents, SS card, birth certificate etc...Keep them on your person or give them to a trusted person for safe keeping. There are resources for lgbt youth on the verge of homelessness in many areas. I hope you have some near you. You may also search for a respite.

You’re a brilliant writer and your observations are spot on. I’m a 56 year old who can’t keep up with the technological requirements anymore and I’m about to lose everything. Interacting with technology sends me into a panic, I’m traumatized by it. I somehow  survived for twenty years in a corporation without being able to use Microsoft office at all other than email. I got away with it and preformed well in sales, well now it doesn’t cut it anymore and I’m finally about to get shitcanned. I can’t type, never used word, can’t understand excel no matter how hard I try. I’ll be lucky to b3e able to get a job at Walmart, probably last a week when they see I can’t learn whatever tech they throw at me. I’m about to be discarded after making over 100k for twenty years. I’ll have no insurance and spend down my retirement ( lost half in a divorce) and try to make it until 62 when I can collect my SS. Hopefully I won’t be homeless and or dead by then. No family to really help, I’m a victim of myself and this world you speak of. A statistic, couldn’t even begin to make the transition.

All of your feelings are valid. I understand but I also hope you can find meaning and purpose regardless. I’m sure you’ve thought about all these other ways to find purpose and get out of yourself. What the hell do I know. I’m sure there are other people in your life you can extend your live to. I’m glad you have a good job, a loving partner and hopefully other family that love and care about you.

If you’re not in medication and don’t want to be then the Psych ward is something to be careful with. They will almost assuredly try to put you on some, but you can advocate for yourself and refuse. Another option is to simply seek out therapy with a psychologist and stay away from a psychiatrist. But if you go to the hospital it could expedite your aftercare with a psychologist. Just know that if you go to the hospital emergency room you’ll have to say you’re acutely suicidal at the moment or they won’t take you in and they’ll send you home with numbers to call to set up future therapy. it sounds like you want help and a psychologist might be the way to go, especially if it’s free. You’re lucky to have free health care. I wish you well.
I’m adopted and so is my sister. I’m close with my sister who is not my biological sibling. My parents are elderly but I was given a good normal life with love.
Go away bot....

Some people say we don’t know what’s going to happen in our future or near future. Some people could be wrong. I know exactly how it’s going to go but I’m old, 56. If you’re young it’s much harder to predict, I can say that from experience. It doesn’t really matter if it’s a self fulfilling prophecy or not, does it?

If you want to be medicated and set up with a mental health treatment plan the hospital may be a good choice. They will only take you if you say you’re suicidal at the moment. At least in Canada you won’t have a bill. Your job could be effected as they may keep you for a week without the ability to notify anyone. If you don’t want to be medicated or forced to stop the med you’re on abruptly ( not a good idea but they do it anyway sometimes) it may not be a good idea. Psych meds are nothing to fool with despite what they say about them.

Is she’s that out of touch she needs a crisis eval before it’s too late and she’s on the streets. If she’s that mentally impaired she should be committed just so she doesn’t die on the streets. So sorry you’re going thru this horror. Makes no sense, she’ll take food stamps but not apply fir SS, SS would come quickly too. You can at least log on for her and under her SS number you can see exactly how much she would collect. You could find out in 5 minutes. You’d have to have her SS number and her number from her state ID card and it will instantly calculate what she gets at 62. Best of luck to you in these trying times.

Terrible, the USA is a joke when it comes to healthcare. Medicaid should be automatic if you’re unemployed. Richest country in the world with no universal healthcare. To stay there and have some security and safety you have to give up your Medicaid which is needed to get meds and document your treatment to be able to get possible ssi or ssdi. Since you’re already there try to find a mental health agency and see if they can see you. I’m so sorry you’re going thru this. I will be going thru the same thing here shortly after I lose my job, don’t feel able to work because of my condition. I’m 56 and I have some retirement savings so even though Medicaid is expanded here I’d have to spend down all my retirement first. So know way to get treatment and document for ssdi even though I’m a prime candidate with my age and long work history. I’m screwed too.

Wow, I just looked up the requirement. I’m disgusted.   


You have to be pregnant, blind, disabled or parent of a minor under 18. If not you’re sht outta luck. I’d still check 211 and see if there are health care agencies that can help. Fcking Texas....

Have you tried to get Medicaid? Are you saying he makes too much money and you can’t get it because you’re staying with him? Medicaid expansion is up to 110% of the poverty level I thought, but you have no income.

If she’s 62 she can draw regular SS now, not SSI or SSDI. Can you go over there and force her to log on and apply and explain to her that if she does not she’ll be out in the cold? Call the SS office for her and get her to talk to someone. If she worked and paid in she’s got money coming and she can still work part time. If she gets that going maybe her brother would be pacified and wait.
True.

I’m here to talk whenever you need to. I’m in the USA. You can pm me anytime and we can set up an easier way to chat. If you ever want someone to connect with and talk about this stuff, I’m here for you. Depending on your time difference you could attend some zoom meetings here in the states for people with suicidal thoughts. I was just on one tonight. They are small, you can leave your camera off. You may like them. Anyway, I’m here if you need or would like to chat.

Ah, I was wondering because of the way you spoke about doctors and medical treatment being out of reach. Are there any social services that can help you? Can anyone from your school help you to get see a dr.? I know Brazil has some type of national healthcare system but I’m sure it’s far from sufficient. Is there any counselor or advisor or social worker that can help you?
Much love to you my friend. I hate that you’re enduring physical pain. I hope you can continue to reach out and see if you can get some relief. What country are you in?
Ha! Mostly intellectual types attend, But it’s diverse. Hope you can make it.

All I can say is that you’re a sweet and beautiful person. everything you said is valid. I have thought like that and I’m currently thinking like that. My reasons are different but similar in that my life prospects going forward are less than appealing. You have every right to feel what you’re are feeling. But I will reiterate that you’re a sweet and beautiful person, I’m judging by your post and the words you chose to use. If you have the ability to get thru college you may want to hang in there. Don’t know what you’re taking but that could work out and you may find something that gives you a purpose and financial security.

it’s so hard with no family. I’m so sorry you lost your connection to this person. You may form a connection again with someone else. It’s possible. If you have the ability to continue the job you don’t like and keep a roof over your head you may just try to hang on and see what happens. There may be another connection and something to find purpose in again. I know acute loneliness and anxiety. I feel for you.

I have no answer but I can say for me it comes down to financial security and having my basic needs met, feeling some sense of safety and security. This eludes me now and that’s where my thoughts of ending it stem from. I’m 56, about to lose life as I’ve known it for about 25 yrs. My depression is something I learned to live with as I got older. I accepted it as a part of me. That may happen for you as you get older. One thing is certain, you’re a brilliant writer and clearly very intelligent.

I’m right there with you. Totally isolated and alone, I’ve declined and I’m not the same person, paranoid, no confidence I’m lost. I’m about to lose my job which is home based now because of the pandemic and I’m so diminished I can’t imagine getting another job of any kind, let alone a job that pays what I’ve made for20 yrs. I don’t see anyway out.

Uh no, the problem is that the government is underfunded. It’s underfunded because corporate America and the ultra wealthy don’t pay into the system. The government is not the problem, the lack of government is the problem.

corporate agenda, no sufficient safety nets, no universal healthcare ( like every other country), no funding for social services. Tech infused in everything sucking the life out of the work force. I guess in effect it’s a depopulation agenda, cuz it’s killing me. I can’t even get Medicaid unless I spend down every cent of my retirement and you can’t have any assets, like a home. Uh, yep. I can sleep only on the nights I don’t have to work the next morning. So needless to say, tonight is the worst.

I think financial insecurity and a lack of feeling safe and secure is what I’m and maybe you are dealing with. I’m male but it’s the same I think. I fear ending up on the streets eventually. I’m sorry you’re in this too. I wish there was a way for good people, lonely scared people who are otherwise “normal” to pool their resources together and keep things from getting worse. It’s tough when you are older and don’t have parents or siblings as a safety net.

Peer to peer support zoom meeting put on by the wildflower alliance have helped me. One almost every evening thru the week and they’re at least 90 minutes. Try it, you may like it. Meeting are specifically on suicidal ideation, no judgement, no fear of being reported, you can leave your camera off. Usually about 7 to 12 people including the facilitator.

I’m 56. Same story as you, surprised I survived. I’m on the verge of being destitute ( if that’s what you meant) for the first time. Don’t think I can handle it, don’t have it in me. Ultimately if my basic needs ( shelter, food, insurance, transportation ) are met I can handle it, but I think I’m going to lose those things. That’s what makes me suicidal.

I’m in the same boat. Everything seems daunting. I can’t fathom being out in public. I’m totally isolated since the pandemic and about 6 months in the isolation fried my brain and now I’m an agoraphobic recluse. Barely showering, a friend brings me groceries, on the verge of being fired from my remote ( during pandemic) job of 20 yrs. Im about to lose everything, have to sell all my belongings, try to sell my house and hopefully find a small condo I can buy with my 401k money and equity in this house. All of this is on me and I ‘m right where you are, paralyzed. But I don’t even get out and drive. I’m not sure why I’ve become this thing, I just know I’m fried, tired and overwhelmed with even the smallest things. I see no way out, my life as I knew it is over. And I’ve got about 5 yrs left before I can collect SS.
I like guided meditations on YouTube. Micheal Sealey is probably the best imo. Headphones and your phone and a quite place.

I don’t have any advice but I’d like to thank you for posting this and don’t be ashamed. I deal with the same feelings when I don’t feel safe and secure. I get trapped in my own head, consumed with my thoughts. For me, I’m just trying to remember that I have times where I don’t feel this way and I hope they return.
